[2023 summer phd probability — problem 1]

Part I, Exercise 1. Let $(X_n)_{n\ge1}$ be a sequence of random variables.
Prove the equivalence: $X_n \xrightarrow{P} 0 \iff \mathbb{E}[\min(1, |X_n|)] \to 0$.

response.text:
Let  
\[
Y_n:=\min(1,|X_n|).
\]
Then \(0\le Y_n\le 1\) for all \(n\).

We prove both directions.

---

## \((\Rightarrow)\) Suppose \(X_n\xrightarrow{P}0\). Show \(\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\to 0\).

Fix \(\varepsilon>0\). Then split according to the events \(\{|X_n|\le \varepsilon\}\) and \(\{|X_n|>\varepsilon\}\):

\[
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]
=
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)\mathbf 1_{\{|X_n|\le \varepsilon\}}]
+
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)\mathbf 1_{\{|X_n|>\varepsilon\}}].
\]

On \(\{|X_n|\le \varepsilon\}\), we have \(\min(1,|X_n|)\le |X_n|\le \varepsilon\). On \(\{|X_n|>\varepsilon\}\), we have \(\min(1,|X_n|)\le 1\). Hence

\[
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]
\le \varepsilon + \mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon).
\]

Since \(X_n\xrightarrow{P}0\), for every fixed \(\varepsilon>0\),

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)\to 0.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\limsup_{n\to\infty}\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\le \varepsilon.
\]

Because \(\varepsilon>0\) was arbitrary, we conclude

\[
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\to 0.
\]

---

## \((\Leftarrow)\) Suppose \(\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\to 0\). Show \(X_n\xrightarrow{P}0\).

Fix \(\varepsilon>0\). It suffices to show

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)\to 0.
\]

First suppose \(0<\varepsilon\le 1\). On the event \(\{|X_n|>\varepsilon\}\), we have

\[
\min(1,|X_n|)\ge \varepsilon.
\]

Thus

\[
\varepsilon \mathbf 1_{\{|X_n|>\varepsilon\}}
\le \min(1,|X_n|).
\]

Taking expectations gives

\[
\varepsilon \mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)
\le \mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)].
\]

Hence

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)
\le \frac{1}{\varepsilon}\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\to 0.
\]

If \(\varepsilon>1\), then

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)
\le \mathbb P(|X_n|>1),
\]

and the case \(\varepsilon=1\) follows similarly by using, for example, any \(0<\delta<1\), since

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>1)\le \mathbb P(|X_n|>\delta)\to 0.
\]

Therefore, for every \(\varepsilon>0\),

\[
\mathbb P(|X_n|>\varepsilon)\to 0.
\]

Thus

\[
X_n\xrightarrow{P}0.
\]

---

Hence,

\[
\boxed{
X_n\xrightarrow{P}0
\iff
\mathbb E[\min(1,|X_n|)]\to 0.
}
\]
